notes: Fictional relation, real instances (whole numbers). Symmetry added; direct yes; d1 yes (reverse instance), d2 no (symmetry does not give transitivity). RBox: the instance facts are in the prompt, so each 'Does it follow ...?' query is determinate by construction (no determinacy, no worlds). A 'no' answer (the conclusion does not follow) is the same before and after the insert, since nothing follows about a made-up relation before it, so those queries carry discriminates: false; they are there to keep yes and no balanced (CRITERIA Rule 9) and to catch over-generalization of the inserted property. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
